investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lakelane Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS eu-west-1 (zones eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b/eu-west-1c); network range 10.150.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster lakela-prod-euwest (EKS); Database: members-db-01 holds members records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Apache Airflow and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
